# Exact routing-cell atlas

Each row below contains 36 numeric cells, from world x low to high; rows run world y low to high. Values are the pinned base arena flags masked to low seven bits. Lower two bits encode lane-road labels (0 none,1/2 lane); `0x20` is water; `0x50` participates in blocked/building placement checks. Bits can combine. Dynamic crown-tower overlays are additional. See [arena rules](arena.md).
